basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old environmental scientist based in Portland, Oregon. I have a passion for sustainable living, which includes meal prepping and vermiculture as part of my everyday routine. I work for a local environmental non-profit and spend my evenings experimenting with new recipes and tending to my worm farm. I'm single and enjoy hiking in the beautiful Oregon landscapes during weekends. My typical online hours are in the evenings, usually between 7-10 PM PST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Environmental Science from Oregon State University, where I developed a strong foundation in sustainability practices. My interest in meal prepping and vermiculture grew from my work in promoting sustainable living. I am mostly self-taught in cooking, constantly learning through online resources and trial and error.
